verdict.rationale: A live probe found https://docs.apify.com/llms.txt returning HTTP 200 with an Apify Documentation index, so an agent can be pointed at it directly. Many docs pages are also served as raw .md URLs (API clients, SDK, webhooks), and an OpenAPI spec is available, which gives agents machine-readable, agent-friendly docs. missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of agents actually consuming llms.txt or the markdown docs in practice.
